title: Uniform torsion cohomology bound for geometric fibres of a proper morphism
statement: Let $p:X\to Y$ be a proper morphism of schemes [def-weil-proper-morphism], with $Y$ quasi-compact [def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme]. There exists an integer $c\geq0$ such that for every geometric point $\bar y:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to Y$ with $\Omega$ algebraically closed [def-weil-geometric-point], every torsion abelian sheaf $F$ on the small etale site of $X_{\bar y}=X\times_Y\operatorname{Spec}\Omega$ [def-pc-base-change, def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], and every $i>c$, one has $H^i((X_{\bar y})_{\mathrm{et}},F)=0$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology]. Torsion means that each local section is killed by some nonzero integer; no common annihilator is assumed. Empty fibres and the empty base are allowed.
